props.description: A record linking a workcenter to a specific product it is allowed to produce.  This record contains many attributes to be taken into consideration when producing the product.

props.label: Update
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

fields.name: order
fields.description: An order to be considered when multiple workcenters are capable of producing the same product.
fields.label: Order

fields.name: standardRate
fields.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.
fields.label: Standard Rate

fields.name: setupRate
fields.description: The amount of time setup takes.  This is always in terms of "Hours" .
fields.label: Setup Rate

fields.name: idealRate
fields.description: The Ideal Rate is used for indicating 100% run time, 100% quality what you would expect the workcenter to produce. This rate is used in OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.
fields.label: Ideal Rate

fields.name: quotedRate
fields.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.
fields.label: Quoted Rate

fields.name: cycleTime
fields.description: Cycle time is measured in Seconds per Inventory Unit
fields.label: Cycle Time

fields.name: unitPerCycle
fields.description: Plex Part Operation Multiple. This indicates the quantity produced per cycle
fields.label: Unit Per Cycle

fields.name: productionOperators
fields.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.
fields.label: Production Operators

fields.name: setupOperators
fields.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.
fields.label: Setup Operators

fields.name: distributionPercentage
fields.description:
The percentage of the Work Order Qty to be allocated to this workcenter. Total of all alternate workcenters plus primary workcenter on productStrategyProcess should not exceed 100%.
if set to zero - distribution record will still be created with 0 assigned qty.

Default 0 (Do not automatically assign any quantity to WC on distribution creation)
fields.label: Distribution Percentage

fields.name: minimumProductionRunTime
fields.description: In hours the minimum amount of time a production run can be scheduled for.  (Ex: 8-hour job with 2-hour min will get up to 4 schedules with setup time per each if there is availability on a calendar)
fields.label: Minimum Production Run Time

fields.name: productionOffalAllowed
fields.description:
Production Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a production mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter
fields.label: Production Offal Allowed

fields.name: setupOffalAllowed
fields.description:
Setup Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a setup mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter
fields.label: Setup Offal Allowed

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: An id referencing a similar object in another system.
fields.label: External Id

fields.name: active
fields.description: Is this approval active?
fields.label: Active

fields.name: defaultDistribution
fields.description:
if default distribution = True, this approved workcenter will create a work order distribution record upon work order creation.
when false - no distribution will be created for this WC but can be added to the WO manually after the fact
fields.label: Default Distribution

fields.name: useWorkcenterRates
fields.description: If Use Global Rate is set to true, the global rate defined on the workcenter record will be used and any rates entered on the approved workcenter will be ignored.
fields.label: Use Workcenter Rates

fields.name: setDefault
fields.description: Copy this workcenter to the process record as default workcenter
fields.label: Set As Default

props.label: Standard Rate
props.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Ideal Rate
props.description: The Ideal Rate is used for indicating 100% run time, 100% quality what you would expect the workcenter to produce. This rate is used in OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Quoted Rate
props.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Distribution Percentage
props.description:
The percentage of the Work Order Qty to be allocated to the primary workcenter. Total of all alternates and primary workcenters should not exceed 100%. if set to zero - distribution record will still be created with 0 assigned qty.

(REQUIRED, Default 100 (100% for primary workcenter))

props.label: Time To Start
props.description: Required time in seconds until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Quantity To Start
props.description: Required quantity (in productStrategy.consumtionUnit) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Percent To Start
props.description: Required percent (of total quantity) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Document Design
props.description: document object

props.label: Production Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a production mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Setup Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a setup mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Minimum Production Run Time
props.description: In hours the minimum amount of time a production run can be scheduled for.  (Ex: 8-hour job with 2-hour min will get up to 4 schedules with setup time per each if there is availability on a calendar)

props.label: Description
props.description: description
